atAGlance: Phở bò viên is beef phở with springy beef meatballs, clear broth, rice noodles, herbs, and lime. It is a good choice when you want texture without rare slices.
whatItIs: Phở bò viên is phở with beef meatballs instead of sliced beef. The meatballs are springy and mild, while the broth still carries the phở aroma.
howToEnjoy: Slice or bite the meatballs with noodles and herbs. Add chili sauce slowly so the beef broth stays clear.
howLocalsOrder: Say Phở bò viên when the beef meatballs are the part you want, not just a plain beef bowl. Locals season lightly at the table, then use extra herbs or bean sprouts only if the broth still feels too heavy.
worthKnowing: Bò viên appears across Vietnamese noodle shops and street snacks. In phở, it is the easiest beef topping if rare meat makes you nervous.
goodToKnow: Bò viên are bouncy beef meatballs. The texture is firmer than sliced beef and easy to recognize in a mixed phở menu.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở bò viên.
